title: Rejected: sparse/header-only alias-on validation as a substitute for full 4Expert model verification

context.goal: Continue toward 10 tok/s vendor DeepSeek under 16GB RAM/page-cache limit with correctness always enforced.

evaluated_options.option: Use llama-gguf on the 64MiB header range
evaluated_options.finding: llama-gguf can read GGUF data/header but does not instantiate llama_model::load_tensors(), so it cannot exercise the DeepSeek4 tid2eid alias code path.

evaluated_options.option: Create a sparse 164.5GB logical file from the 64MiB header and run llama-cli with alias envs
evaluated_options.finding: This would map zero-filled holes for missing tensor data. It might exercise some load path, but all missing weights would be zero, so output correctness and TTFT/token-rate results would be invalid. It could also generate misleading page-cache behavior unrelated to the real GGUF.

evaluated_options.option: Use sparse/header-only data for a strict cold benchmark
evaluated_options.finding: Rejected because correctness would not be meaningful and the benchmark would not represent the real 4Expert Q4_K model.

decision.reason: The user's constraints require correctness and valid cold-start TTFT/token-rate evidence. Header-only or sparse-zero files cannot satisfy those requirements.
decision.valid_next_step: Obtain the complete 4Expert GGUF on disk or another real mmap/readable backing store, then run alias-on metadata/load, Q4_K stream/cache diagnostics, top1 correctness, France correctness, and strict cold benchmark.

required_disk_action.candidate_requiring_approval: /root/lfz/models/GLM-5.2-UD-IQ3_XXS (~263G, unrelated to current vendor DS4 SOTA)
